name: Divine Maiden's Birth
descriptionTemplate: Gain a total of (Max HP [Block:Arg1]% + [Block:Arg2]) Shield and [Arg3] Arithmetica. At the start of the next turn, take Max HP [Arg5]% {Sacrifice}. {Aftershock}: {Tentacle DMG} +[TentaclePower:Arg4].
lore:
She is a false holy maiden. Every gesture sacrilege, every act unfit for the role.

But beneath that defiant veneer? Perhaps wresting control of her fate was the truest saintly act.
